problem: High pedestrian heat exposure where shade is limited
description: Add shade to exposed walking corridors represented by the Argus shade intervention.
appropriate_when: The simulator reports elevated heat stress and exposed destinations or routes.

problem: Heat exposure along heavily used pedestrian routes
description: Test the existing Argus shade action where route use and modeled exposure overlap.
appropriate_when: Heat and crowding occur together on identified routes.
expected_effects: reduce modeled heat burden on selected trips
tradeoffs: may require prioritizing a subset of corridors

problem: Heavy rainfall with poor drainage and flood exposure
description: Test the existing Argus drainage intervention for rain-related mobility penalties.
appropriate_when: The simulator reports meaningful rain impact at buildings or routes.
tradeoffs: civil works and maintenance would need engineering assessment

problem: Rain disrupts pedestrian access on low-drainage routes
intervention: Improve drainage along affected pedestrian links
description: Use the executable drainage action and let the simulator test its modeled effect.
appropriate_when: Problem routes coincide with elevated rain impact.
tradeoffs: site-specific hydraulic design is outside Argus

problem: High pedestrian crowding on constrained corridors
description: Test additional modeled route capacity to redistribute pedestrian demand.
appropriate_when: The simulator reports crowding above its intervention threshold.
tradeoffs: new route feasibility and accessibility require site review

description: Use the Argus alternative-route action to test demand redistribution.
appropriate_when: Problem buildings and routes show concentrated crowding.
expected_effects: reduce modeled concentration on busy routes

problem: Heat and crowding combine on pedestrian corridors
description: Rank executable actions using the actual stress metrics and retrieved context.
appropriate_when: Heat is the dominant simulator issue within a compound event.
tradeoffs: one intervention may not address every modeled stressor

problem: Rain and crowding disrupt access simultaneously
intervention: Test drainage improvement for the rain component
description: Select an executable action for one measured component and re-simulate.
appropriate_when: Rain impact is elevated in a compound scenario.
expected_effects: allow simulator-based comparison of rain impact
tradeoffs: crowding may require a separate route intervention

problem: Prototype stress indicators remain below action thresholds
description: Preserve the baseline when the deterministic simulator advisor finds no threshold breach.
appropriate_when: All modeled stress indicators remain below intervention thresholds.
tradeoffs: continue monitoring as scenario conditions change
